text:
Samantha: Quick sync  we want the blog + social live tomorrow 11:30am PT. Need final changelog blurb, docs URL, a single benchmark hero stat, canary/rollout timing, and webinar promo copy + RSVP link. Also confirm lead routing for signups (HubSpot tag). @Jason @Elaine @Karl

Jason: Can do. Canary plan: start 10:45am PT (15m canary), then staged ramp to full at ~1:00pm PT. Auto-rollback threshold: +4% error or +10% p95 latency. Model artifacts: rwd-server/v1.3 and rwd-server/v1.3-quant.

Elaine: Docs link is up: https://docs.redwood.com/release/v1-3  added migration guide and SDK examples. I'll add a small benchmark table and a short migration note for Dedicated customers.

Maria: Changelog request  we need a 1-2 sentence lead for the post, plus one code example we can embed (short). Can marketing get final by 6pm PT so we can lock creative?

Jason: Changelog (1-liner): "v1.3 boosts inference throughput with workload-aware batching and shared KV caching; the optional quantized build cuts cost by ~2.5x for many production prompts with a sub-5% p95 latency tradeoff."

Karl: Benchmark hero: "~2.6x token/sec steady-state uplift vs v1.2 at 512 seq on L4 profiles." I'll attach the PNG to the docs page.

Samantha: Example embed for the post? Need short code block we can screenshot.

Jason: Example snippet for blog: `POST /v1/generate
model: rwd-server/v1.3
prompt: "Summarize the following release notes..."
max_tokens: 120`

Maria: Marketing note: for messaging please emphasize cost/perf tradeoffs and easy migration (pin version in API). Also mention canary + rollback policy so enterprise customers know the safety measures.

Samantha: Webinar: 30m pre-record (demo) + 30m live Q&A at 2pm PT release day. Speakers: Maria (product), Jason (runtime), Karl (bench). Promo copy draft: "See what's new in v1.3: faster steady-state throughput, lower inference costs, and tips to migrate with zero downtime. Join our demo + live Q&A." Need RSVP link that creates HubSpot lead with tag `release_v1.3`.

hubsync-bot: RSVP form created: https://redwood.com/rsvp/v1-3 (leads will be tagged `release_v1.3` and routed to marketing-inbound).

Samantha: Perfect  we'll queue the social and blog but will not publish until changelog + docs URL + benchmark hero PNG are confirmed. Holding creative until 6pm PT.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 1769972700 (10:45am PT); full rollout scheduled: 1769984400 (1:00pm PT). Will post status updates to #release-war-room.

Jason: Ops note  monitoring alerts will trigger a marketing ping for any rollback. Also adding a short migration snippet in docs for Dedicated customers that shows how to pin `model=rwd-server/v1.3`.

Samantha: Thanks everyone  please update this thread when the PNG and final 1-line changelog are in.
